title: SAAHAA — how it works
name: How SAAHAA Works
subtitle: One circle for every service and every shop in your neighbourhood. Locally, professionally.

sections.title: Customer
sections.intro: NEED → SERVICE → DETAILS → MATCH → PRICE → CONFIRM. Three taps to a locked price, a code at the door, money held until the work is confirmed.

slides.title: Home — everything your neighbourhood needs
slides.caption: One search finds people who come to you, shops that deliver to you, and your own orders. Services are grouped Home & Repairs · Care & Wellbeing · Learn, Move & Live · Shops Near You, rendered live from the registry.

slides.title: Sign in — a number and a password
slides.caption: No names, no OTP theatre: a mobile number and a password you chose. Five wrong tries and the door slows down (30 s, doubling) — per number, remembered across reloads.

slides.title: Your place — anywhere in the world
slides.caption: Search any address (OpenStreetMap), use the device's location, or drag the pin. Enrolment and service are no longer bounded by a list of Hyderabad areas; the old names still resolve.

slides.title: Search is the front door
slides.caption: Instant results across services, sub-services, shops, products and orders. Recent searches and suggestions are real destinations, never decoration.

slides.title: Home & Repairs — the Best Match
slides.caption: Ranked on trust, distance and price — not cheapest-first. One dominant card: name, rating, trust band, distance, ETA, a locked price, and why this person.

slides.title: Care & Wellbeing — tier-gated
slides.caption: In-home care needs a Background-Checked pro. The match only ever shows people who cleared that rung.

slides.title: Learn, Move & Live
slides.caption: Tutors, moving, events, pets — the same locked-match card, the same code at the door.

slides.title: Ask rates — when more than one pro is free
slides.caption: Under Confirm: “Ask rates from 4 more workers.” Your held price stays reserved, so asking cannot cost you anything.

slides.title: Rates are in
slides.caption: Sorted by score, never by price. The cheapest is always shown with an honest line about rating and distance. One tap books.

slides.title: The receipt teaches
slides.caption: You asked 5 workers. You paid ₹1,161. You saved ₹92. Next time the button says “Last time you saved ₹92.”

slides.title: Shops near you
slides.caption: Kirana, vegetables, meat, dairy, pharmacy, water — compact, information-rich cards; delivery or pickup; the cart floats in only when it matters.

slides.title: Cart and checkout
slides.caption: One bill, substitution choices per item, minimum order enforced, one primary action.

slides.title: Your wallet
slides.caption: Everyone pays SAAHAA, and SAAHAA pays everyone. A booking is funded from your wallet first and only the shortfall is collected; a refund lands back in the wallet; top up or take out to UPI whenever you like. Until the gateway is wired every screen says so: Sandbox UPI, no real money moves yet.

slides.title: Live tracker
slides.caption: Requested → Matched → Accepted → On the way → Started → Completed → Paid. The current stage is the hero of the screen; the next action sits right under it.

slides.title: Where your pro is
slides.caption: One tap on the tracker opens a real map: your place, your pro, the straight-line distance between them. The pin re-reads the pro's position on every render.

slides.title: My SAAHAA
slides.caption: Bookings, orders, wallet legs from the ledger, chats, reviews, settings — one connected hub, not a settings list.

sections.title: Partner
sections.intro: Ten minutes from “I want to earn” to taking jobs — with the owner touching nothing. You keep 100% of your quote, and SAAHAA runs your professional page for you.

slides.title: Earn — locally, professionally
slides.caption: Your trade. Your price. Your own page. No joining fee, ever.

slides.title: Sign up
slides.caption: Name, mobile, trade, area, your usual rate. Two minutes.

slides.title: Set your working place
slides.caption: A partner signs up with the place they work from — searched, located or pinned — so matching uses real distance from day one.

slides.title: Step 1 · Confirm your number
slides.caption: A code to your phone. Your page is already drafted below — the reason to keep going.

slides.title: Step 2 · Show us your ID
slides.caption: Aadhaar, PAN or licence. SAAHAA keeps a scrambled fingerprint and the last 4 digits — never the number.

slides.title: Step 4 · Five trade questions
slides.caption: Things every real pro knows and no impostor does. Four of five to pass.

slides.title: Step 5 · How SAAHAA works
slides.caption: Six rules — OTP at the door, never cash outside, a photo before payout. A wrong answer shows the rule and you try again.

slides.title: You are verified
slides.caption: Tier 2, online, bookable. Your first jobs are up to ₹1,500; three clean jobs and it becomes ₹10,000 by itself.

slides.title: Your page is live
slides.caption: Badge, rating, jobs done, price, what you do, reviews, Book. Built from your work, maintained by SAAHAA, yours to share on WhatsApp.

slides.title: The work cockpit
slides.caption: Online/offline, new requests, today's jobs, earnings split into released · held · sent to UPI, your rates, your standing.

slides.title: Send a rate
slides.caption: The fair price is pre-filled. Drag below it and your chance drops — sending less does not raise it.

slides.title: A job, step by step
slides.caption: Accept → on the way → arrived → the customer's code → before/after photos → finished. Money releases on the customer's confirmation.

slides.title: Standing — approvals that happen by themselves
slides.caption: The Background-Checked checklist, line by line: ladder complete, 3 real jobs settled cleanly, rating 4.3, no upheld dispute, 2 vouches from customers who had a job settle or from same-trade pros, and the reference you named confirmed by a 4-digit code. When every line holds the tier is granted by the system and audited; 14 clean days later, Certified follows the same way. Nobody has to call anybody.

slides.title: Shop owner — merchant command center
slides.caption: Orders, products with inline price and stock, pricing, sales, customers, payouts, setup, analytics — all from the shop's own data.

sections.title: Admin — one owner, one console
sections.intro: The system computes; you decide. Since 7.0 the two decisions that used to reach you every day — a background check and a Certified badge — are earned by the network itself. What is left for you: the disputes that need judgement, the kill switches, and the treasury.

slides.title: Dashboard
slides.caption: Users, partners, orders, revenue, GMV, escrow, approvals, disputes, savings, listings, booking and rating statistics — and the money flow CUSTOMER → ESCROW → PARTNER / SHOP. The live map plots every pro and shop the owner serves — on OpenStreetMap, vendored, no third-party script.

slides.title: Approvals
slides.caption: A background request with its evidence first; Certified candidates after. Nothing below tier 2 ever lands here — and since 7.0 both tiers are granted by the system when the evidence holds, so this queue is for what you choose to do by hand.

slides.title: Bookings & Escrow
slides.caption: Held orders with their release tier; a stuck shop order can be refunded in full.

slides.title: Disputes
slides.caption: Release, partial, or refund — the money moves first; the dispute closes with it.

slides.title: Users & Partners
slides.caption: Trust band, tier, suspend.

slides.title: Moderation
slides.caption: Reviews with their author; hide.

slides.title: Finance
slides.caption: Revenue net of GST, the payout queue, the hash-chained ledger — replay reconciles to ₹0.

slides.title: System & Audit
slides.caption: Health checks, feature flags as kill switches, backups, exports, the self-test suite, the audit log.

slides.title: Charges — the owner's dials
slides.caption: Service markup on top of the worker's quote, the retail take and its cap, the delivery bands by distance, the rider dispatch cut. Validated ranges; Push makes them effective on every quote made afterwards; booked orders keep the fees they were booked with; every push is audited.

slides.title: The Flow tracker
slides.caption: Everyone on SAAHAA, most recently active first: where they are, which step they are on, what they have spent or earned. Tap a row to unroll that person's whole journey; filter by role or stage.

slides.title: Treasury — the company’s wallet
slides.caption: Read from the hash-chained ledger, never computed: fees earned, GST held, and every liability — escrow in flight, customer, worker and shop wallets, stakes, holdbacks, the rider pool. Money in equals liabilities plus ours plus the government’s plus what has already left, and the screen says whether it reconciles. Withdraw fees and Remit GST ask for the password again and are audited.

slides.title: Automation — the dials and the pipeline
slides.caption: The kill switch and the thresholds — jobs, rating, vouches, reference, days at tier 3 — with validated ranges and a Push, beside the pipeline of every pro at tier 2 or 3: who is close, and exactly which line they are waiting on. Approve and suspend by hand still work; suspension always wins.

sections.title: One design, every screen
sections.intro: The same engine and the same screens recompose for the device: a bottom bar and full-height sheets on a phone, an icon rail on a tablet, a persistent side navigation, top bar and centred dialogs on a desktop. Nothing is a stretched phone layout.

slides.title: Home on a desktop
slides.caption: Side navigation and top bar carry location, search, notifications and profile; the hero and the live order sit side by side.

slides.title: Booking becomes a centred dialog
slides.caption: The phone's bottom sheet is a 720px dialog on a large screen — same step bar, same Best Match, same one primary action.

slides.title: Tracker in two columns
slides.caption: Status hero across the top, the timeline pinned on the left, actions and the bill on the right.

slides.title: Shops in a grid
slides.caption: Category chips, market capsules and information-rich shop cards two across.

slides.title: The work cockpit, wide
slides.caption: Jobs and requests on the left; money, standing and the ladder on the right — earnings never blended.

slides.title: The merchant command center, wide
slides.caption: Tabs as a segmented control, the ready-list picker surfaced, products with inline price and stock two across.

slides.title: Verification stays a reading column
slides.caption: A seven-step form is a 760px column on any screen — wide fields are a mistake, not a feature.
